Name: Shubael, Son of Amram
Summary: Son of Amram in the rest of the sons of Levi, father of Jehdeiah.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 24:20: Son of Amram in the rest of the sons of Levi, father of Jehdeiah.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Shubael stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
